## What changed?

Describe the behavior before and after. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Verification

Record what you ran and the result. State what you did not verify. Note whether the change affects Windows x64, ARM64, the portable executable or the Store package.

If the change affects UI, startup, settings, process ownership or diagnostics, describe the relevant checks. Use synthetic or redacted examples only. See [Verification](https://github.com/PeterShanxin/Remote-Commander-Tray/blob/main/docs/verification.md) for the checks that apply.
